DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia, first episode, active phase.

The clinical picture of new-onset bizarre delusions (persecution/control), agitation, social withdrawal, and functional decline over six weeks, in the absence of substance use or prior mood disorders, strongly supports a diagnosis of schizophrenia. I recommend requesting MRI brain images to rule out structural causes before finalizing the treatment plan.
